CREATE TABLE `ingrediente` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `unidad` enum('g','ml','ud') NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_ingrediente_nombre` (`nombre`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=9 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `receta` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `titulo` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `raciones` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '4',
  `dificultad` enum('fácil','media','difícil') NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_receta_titulo` (`titulo`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_receta_raciones` CHECK ((`raciones` between 1 and 20))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `receta_ingrediente` (
  `id_receta` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `id_ingrediente` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `cantidad` decimal(6,1) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_receta`,`id_ingrediente`),
  KEY `fk_ri_ingrediente` (`id_ingrediente`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ri_ingrediente` FOREIGN KEY (`id_ingrediente`) REFERENCES `ingrediente` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ri_receta` FOREIGN KEY (`id_receta`) REFERENCES `receta` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_ri_cantidad` CHECK ((`cantidad` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
